topic: Scopper Gaban's feats (Mountain Eater, God Valley, Sommers, Imu duel) support his claim to be the Roger Pirates' second strongest member over Rayleigh
title: Scopper Gaban Really Was Roger's Second Strongest Pirate
description:
Scopper Gaban explained: Elbaph's giants rank him third in the Roger Pirates, and he insists he was second. This is the chapter-cited case for why he may be right, from the Mountain Eater feat and God Valley to beating a Knight of God and standing up to Imu.

We also steelman Rayleigh's side, including the SBS reports that list him as the crew's number two. Who do you rank second? Tell me in the comments.
comment: Is Gaban the Roger Pirates' real number two, or does Rayleigh's first mate seat and training of Luffy still put him ahead?

lines.text: Scopper Gaban was the second strongest pirate on Roger's crew, and Elbaph keeps proving it.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban elbaph axes, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 1151 has giants ranking him third, and a badly hurt Gaban refuses to let that stand.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban chapter 1151 giants, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So was Rayleigh ever truly ahead of him, or did everyone just assume it?

shot.fallback: anime style scene, silvers rayleigh roger pirates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: I think the proof sits in four fights, and one of them is against Imu himself.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, nerona imu gaban duel, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Mountain Eater, God Valley, the Knights of God, and a duel with a god. But the nicknames already hint at the answer...

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban mountain eater, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Start with the titles. Rayleigh is the Right Hand of the Pirate King, and Gaban is the Left Hand.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh gaban roger pirates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Hajrudin calls them Roger's wings, which only works if both wings are the same size.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, hajrudin gaban rayleigh, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: His fame is written up as rivaling Roger's and Rayleigh's own, which is an odd thing to say about third place.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban legendary pirate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban was also the navigator, and he drew the crew's final route to Laugh Tale in chapter 967.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban navigator laugh tale map, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Think about that. Roger trusted one man to chart the road to the end of the world.

shot.search: Gol D. Roger Gaban Oro Jackson
shot.fallback: anime style scene, gol d. roger gaban oro jackson, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That crew was the first known to circle the whole globe, and his maps were a big part of it.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, roger pirates oro jackson sailing, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's a man at the very center of the crew, not a bodyguard standing in a corner.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban young roger pirates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: The old flashbacks stage the two of them as a pair, too.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh flashback, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In chapter 966, when the crew faces Whitebeard's men, Gaban and Rayleigh lead the charge side by side.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh whitebeard pirates battle, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then Oden storms in, and Gaban and Rayleigh are the two who step up to fight him.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban roger whitebeard bow, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Roger ends it with one slash, but look at who stood in front of the captain first.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban roger shoulder, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: When the crew faces a real threat, those are the two names on the page.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban kozuki oden roger pirates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: The wiki even says that in his youth he was on par with Rayleigh.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh young prime, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So the titles say equals. But what has he actually done that you can measure?

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban axes ready, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here's the first number. Roger had to recover in a hospital in the mountains, and enemy pirates surrounded the two of them.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, roger gaban mountain hospital pirates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban beat every single one of them with two axes, and he cut down every tree on that mountain.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban two axes mountain, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's where the name Mountain Eater comes from, and it's the reason he has an epithet at all.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban mountain-eater, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: One man, two axes, a whole mountain stripped bare, and his captain was in a sickbed the entire time.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban axes roger recovering, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Compare that to Rayleigh's famous feat. At seventy-eight he scares off Blackbeard with presence alone, in episode 1088.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh blackbeard episode 1088, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's real, and it's great. But it's reputation and pressure, not a mountain range of beaten pirates.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh haki pressure blackbeard, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Next number: Edd War. Shiki's armada is lined up, and Roger turns the alliance down.

shot.search: Edd War Shiki armada Roger Pirates
shot.fallback: anime style scene, edd war shiki armada roger pirates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban fights in that battle with the whole crew, and he keeps a panicking Buggy from surrendering.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban buggy edd war, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: A storm sank half of Shiki's fleet, so I won't pretend Gaban won Edd War by himself.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, edd war storm shiki fleet, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But a crew that beats Shiki's armada is not a crew with a weak link.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, roger pirates edd war victory, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now the fight fans forget. God Valley, thirty-eight years ago, in chapter 1162.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, god valley incident gaban ganzui, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: While Rayleigh pulls Shakky out of slavery, Gaban collects treasure and Devil Fruits, and he clashes with Ganzui.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban ganzui god valley treasure, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then John's magnet power nearly rips the axes out of his hands, and Gaban tries to warn Roger in chapter 1163.

shot.search: Gaban John magnet axes God Valley
shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban john magnet axes god valley, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban and Rayleigh then rush inland together to reach Roger and Garp, in chapter 1165.

shot.search: Gaban Rayleigh Roger Garp God Valley
shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh roger garp god valley, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: They arrive after the fight is over and carry Roger and Garp out, while the Knights of God finish off Rocks.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh gaban carry roger garp, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Notice the pairing. When the crew needed its two best, the story sent exactly two men: Gaban and Rayleigh.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh god valley rescue, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Nobody sent a third-ranked fighter to pull a Pirate King out of God Valley. They sent the Left Hand.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban god valley, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Fight three is a Knight of God, a man who is supposed to be unbeatable...

shot.fallback: anime style scene, shepherd sommers knight of god, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 1149. Shepherd Sommers is about to finish Nico Robin, and Gaban gets there first.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban sommers nico robin elbaph, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He cuts off one of Sommers' hands from range, and the hand does not grow back.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban sommers hand, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: The Knights of God are supposed to be immortal, so Sommers honestly looks confused.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, shepherd sommers confused, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban then lands a direct hit across his chest, and Sommers panics and throws up a thorn barrier.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban sommers thorn barrier, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: The wiki says Gaban beat him without an injury, and I think that undersells how clean it was.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban beats sommers, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here is the detail people forget. The wiki credits his Supreme King Haki for holding back that immortality, chapter 1152.

shot.search: Gaban Supreme King Haki Sommers regeneration
shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban supreme king haki sommers regeneration, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Sommers' arm took an extended time to come back, so the regeneration can be slowed.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, sommers arm regenerate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban met Sommers decades earlier, when the Knights of God kept trying to take baby Shanks back, chapter 1170.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban sommers baby shanks, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He helped beat them back every time. A man who protects Shanks from the Knights of God is no benchwarmer.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban shanks knights of god, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In that same chapter 1149, Gaban foresees his son's fate through Future Vision, and he surrenders to save him.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban colon gunko surrender, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's the bravest move in the fight, and it costs him his place on the branch.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban gunko colon branch, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here's the steelman, and I want to be fair. Rayleigh has the better reputation, and he trained Luffy.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh luffy training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He taught Luffy Haki during the two year timeskip, and that is a teacher's résumé.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh luffy haki training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But teaching and ranking are different things. A great coach isn't automatically the better fighter.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh sabaody, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Gaban's record against the immortals is on the page, with chapter numbers attached.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban knights of god record, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Sommers was only the warm-up, though, because Imu himself is about to land on Elbaph...

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu elbaph arrival magic circle, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Imu arrives over Aurust Castle, and Gaban says the Haki feels stronger than anything he felt at God Valley, chapter 1180.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu aurust castle magic circle, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Think about that. He stood in God Valley, and he says this is worse.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban unnerved imu haki, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 1189. Luffy is wounded, and Imu is about to finish him.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu luffy chapter 1189, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban leaps in the way and blocks Imu's blade.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban blocks imu blade, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Imu tries to strike Gaban himself, and Gaban dodges and answers with an insult.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban dodges imu insult, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then he turns to Luffy and scolds him. Failure dooms Elbaph, he says, and the Pirate King's seat is not for the weak.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban scolds luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He tosses Luffy aside and goes on the offensive against Imu himself.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban offensive imu, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Offensive. Not stalling. An old retired navigator goes after the ruler of the world.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban attacks imu axes, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: During the duel he mentions Joy Boy's message on Laugh Tale, and Imu is visibly unnerved.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu unnerved joy boy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Imu demands to know why one of Roger's old crew would protect Luffy like this.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu gaban roger crew, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban says Imu's own obsession with ending Luffy proves Luffy is the man everyone has been waiting for.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban imu luffy waiting, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Imu agrees with him. I love that, because the villain confirms the hero's destiny.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu agrees gaban, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then comes Kamudo. Gaban charges his axes with Supreme King Haki and fires black lightning.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban kamudo black lightning, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: It cuts down huge parts of the Adam Tree, and Imu has to block it.

shot.search: Gaban Kamudo Adam Tree Imu block
shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban kamudo adam tree imu block, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Notice that Imu has to block. To me that says Kamudo was a real threat, not a nuisance.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu blocks kamudo, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Imu even reminds Gaban that, however old, he was once a member of Roger's crew.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu gaban roger crew reminder, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's the closest thing to a power rating Imu himself has ever given us. I'd take it seriously.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu gaban rating, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then Gaban's Yachitakeru meets Imu's Honebami, and Gaban ends the clash incapacitated, his left arm gone.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban yachitakeru imu honebami, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now the counterpoint, and it matters. Gaban lost that exchange, and fans will say that settles the ranking.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban defeated imu, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But Imu was surprised Gaban survived with only one arm lost, and I'd call that a statement.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, imu surprised gaban survived, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Even Luffy and Loki together struggled to hurt Imu afterward, chapter 1192, so losing to him is no ranking.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, luffy loki imu battle, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So which old pirate has a better answer to a god? Right now only Gaban has one on the page...

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban imu god duel, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here's a detail from after the fight that changes how I read him.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban luffy after imu fight, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban was ready to stay behind and hold Imu off so Luffy could escape Elbaph, chapter 1191.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban orders luffy leave elbaph, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Luffy refused, and Hajrudin punched Imu away with Gungnir to buy them a moment.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, hajrudin gungnir imu, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban was relieved to have help, and then kept right on arranging Luffy's escape.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban hajrudin luffy escape, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: A man who thinks he's the weaker wing doesn't volunteer to hold off a god alone.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban holds imu, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then Usopp walks in and tells Gaban he's forcing his own beliefs onto Luffy's fate, chapter 1192.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, usopp gaban luffy fate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban is stunned, and he wonders aloud where Usopp had been the whole time.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban stunned usopp, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's a great character beat, and it also shows Gaban thinking about the whole war, not one fight.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban usopp elbaph, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now Shanks. A year after Roger's execution, he visits Gaban's home, and they soak in a hot spring talking about the old days.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, shanks gaban hot spring, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban fought off the Knights of God for baby Shanks, and Shanks still trusts him with the old stories.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, shanks gaban elbaph, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In chapter 1139, the two of them together stop Harald's rampage, after Harald is changed by a Depths Covenant.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban shanks harald rampage, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's Gaban standing at an Emperor's level, years after both of them left the sea behind.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban shanks emperor, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He announces himself by tossing a gigantic axe around like it's nothing. That's not a fading warrior.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban gigantic axe harald, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He senses the Knights of God arriving from across the island in chapter 1139, long before anyone else.

shot.search: Gaban Observation Haki Knights of God
shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban observation haki knights of god, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then he counts three of them in chapter 1145 through their hidden Haki.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban observation haki three knights, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's a commander's skill set, and I'd argue it's rarer than raw strength.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban observation haki, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So the question for the final stretch is the one this whole video turns on: what does Rayleigh have that Gaban doesn't?

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh gaban comparison, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: One more scene. Chapter 1152, and Luffy is about to head up for the final fight.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, luffy elbaph lift chapter 1152, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban waves him down and says his Supreme King Haki can be used against the Knights of God.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban luffy supreme king haki, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Then he says there's another Supreme King Haki user in Luffy's crew.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban another haki user, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: It's Zoro, and Zoro had absolutely no idea.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, roronoa zoro surprised haki, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban is appalled, and tells him that as Luffy's second, he should always be ready to have his captain's back.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban scolds zoro first mate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Gaban noticed what Zoro's own crew missed, and what Zoro himself missed.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban zoro supreme king haki, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now watch what that means for ranking. Supreme King Haki is rare, one person in several million, chapter 519.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, supreme king haki rare rayleigh, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Spotting it, judging its potential and knowing what it takes to awaken it is rarer still.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban haki understanding, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Rayleigh taught Luffy Haki. But Gaban is the one who found Zoro's.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh zoro luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Except there's one real problem with my case, and I owe you the honest version of it...

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh debate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Reports on one of Oda's SBS say Rayleigh is listed as the crew's number two.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, oda sbs rayleigh number two, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: I'm going by secondhand coverage of that SBS here, so treat the exact wording with care.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, one piece sbs volume, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 1151 also plays Gaban's claim as a joke, with a hurt old man correcting the giants.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban corrects giants chapter 1151, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So I won't tell you canon agrees with him. It doesn't. Not yet.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh canon, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Rayleigh also has the Dark King title and that Blackbeard staredown in episode 1088.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh dark king blackbeard, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here's my read. A number two in an SBS can mean first mate, the role, not the second strongest fighter.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh first mate roger pirates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Rayleigh was the first mate, and that's a title about leadership. Gaban's claim is about fighting.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh first mate gaban fighter, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And the best leader isn't always the second strongest, as any Straw Hat fan can tell you.

shot.search: Straw Hat Pirates first mate Zoro
shot.fallback: anime style scene, straw hat pirates first mate zoro, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So I think the SBS settles who ranked second, not who hit harder.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh ranking, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So what does the page itself say when you put the two résumés side by side?

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh side by side, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Put them side by side. Gaban has the Mountain Eater feat, the Knights of God and a duel with Imu.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban feats imu duel, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Rayleigh has the teacher's chair, the Dark King title and the first mate's seat.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh dark king, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Both stood in God Valley, and both carried Roger out of it together.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh carry roger, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: On the page, only one of them has been shown cutting down an immortal Knight of God.

shot.search: Gaban Sommers Knight of God defeated
shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban sommers knight of god defeated, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Only one has been shown trading blows with the ruler of the world.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban imu clash kamudo, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: I won't call that a clean win, because we haven't seen Rayleigh's best in years.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, rayleigh haki strongest, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But if you count only what's on the manga page, Gaban's list is longer and louder.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban rayleigh list, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And a man who thought he was third wouldn't be correcting giants while badly hurt.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban correcting giants, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: My verdict: on the evidence we've seen, Gaban was Rayleigh's equal, and I'd give him second place.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, scopper gaban rayleigh equal, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Oda hasn't ruled on that in the manga itself, so this is my read, not canon.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, gaban roger left hand, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And if you want to see who really led the fight at God Valley, that's the next story.

shot.fallback: anime style scene, god valley incident roger rocks, dramatic lighting, no text

self_check.hook: Everyone believes X, chapter 1151 says otherwise: line 1 states the claim, line 2 cites the third-strongest insult
